title: Our Google Pixel 11 battery life and charging tests are ready
description: Last year, the Pixel 10 delivered less-than-stellar battery life results from its 4,970mAh battery – this was the first generation with Tensor chipsets fabbed by TSMC, so, clearly, there were some teething issues. It’s a year later and we’re putting the Google Pixel 11 through the same battery and charging tests. Google kept battery capacity essentially the same at 4,985mAh, but it optimized the rest of the hardware to reduce power draw. Let’s find out whether it was successful. Indeed it was! With an Active Use Score of 15:40h, the Pixel 11 left its predecessor in the dust – the 2025...

title: Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 Pro series' India launch date confirmed, packs a 10,000 mAh battery
description: Xiaomi unveiled the Redmi Note 17 Pro in China in July and later introduced it globally in August alongside the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max. It started teasing the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max in India last week, and today the company said the Redmi Note 17 Pro series will debut in India on September 15. When strength meets power, you get a mAhster. Meet the all-new #REDMINote17ProSeries. A powerhouse that pushes limits, takes on more and raises the bar. The #mAhsterOfStrength arrives on 15th September, 2026. Get notified: https://t.co/M54WEAYbgA pic.twitter.com/hJTK9JH0dk— Redmi India (@RedmiIndia)...

description: The iQOO 16 launch has been officially teased, with the company also confirming that an iQOO Pad Ultra is also coming soon. Both devices are already available for pre-order in China. In a post on Weibo, the vivo sub-brand revealed that the iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra will debut in China toward the end of this month. While the company has not shared any specifications for the upcoming devices, it has given us a glimpse of their designs. The iQOO 16 teaser is seen with the redesigned rear camera module that leaked last week. Meanwhile, the iQOO Pad Ultra teaser reveals a...

title: Realme 16 Pro and Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition unveiled
description: Last year, Realme teamed up with Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products for the Realme 15 Pro Game of Thrones Limited Edition. Today, the company announced another partnership with Warner Bros. for new limited-edition products, this time inspired by the Harry Potter universe. The Realme products getting the Harry Potter treatment are the Realme 16 Pro and the Realme Buds T500 Pro TWS earphones. The Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition and the Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition are expected to have the same hardware as the standard models, but come with very different...

title: It's official - the Oppo F35 series is launching in India soon
description: Oppo has officially confirmed that the F35 series will launch in India soon. This launch was rumored back in August – back then, the scuttlebutt was that the F35 models will launch alongside the Find X9s Pro. However, Oppo is still mum on that part. As for the Oppo F35 models, we’ve heard of at least two – the Oppo F35 Pro and the F35 Pro Max (note that the actual names may be different). Alas, the teasers only show anonymous silhouettes, so we can’t tell how many phones there actually are in the series. The August rumors claimed that the F35 Pro Max will be a re-branded Oppo A7 Pro...

title: Xiaomi 18 Fold hands-on
description: Passport-sized folds are the trend these days, and the freshly announced Xiaomi 18 Fold wants to capitalize on the momentum. We already brought you an “eyes-on” preview from the Xiaomi showbooth at IFA 2026, and we can now share our first impressions after spending some quality time with the device. Right off the bat, the 18 Fold feels decently light considering the 7.58-inch folding display. Xiaomi’s numbers claim 219 grams, placing the 18 Fold in the same weight class as the Xiaomi 17 Ultra but a cool 18 grams heavier than the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8. And yes, we managed to snap some...

title: OnePlus N6 Lite teased
description: OnePlus has officially teased the launch of a new N6 series smartphone in India. The upcoming OnePlus N6 Lite will join the N6 and N6x, and is expected to be the most affordable model in the lineup. While OnePlus has yet to announce an official launch date, a tipster claims that the N6 Lite could be unveiled toward the end of this month and may come with 4GB of RAM. The official teaser for the upcoming phone offers a partial look at its front design. The device appears to feature a flat display and flat frame, along with a hole-punch cutout for the selfie camera. The teaser also...

title: Infinix Xpad 30 Pro launches with 11-inch display and 8,200mAh battery
description: Infinix has unveiled its latest Xpad 30 Pro Android tablet in global markets. It comes with a large 11-inch display and is powered by a MediaTek Helio chipset. The Infinix Xpad 30 Pro sports a 2.5K resolution LCD display that offers up to 90Hz refresh rate and 550 nits of max brightness. It’s powered by the octa-core Helio G200 Ultimate chipset, which can be paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of internal UFS 2.2 storage. description: Samsung released Wear OS 7-based One UI 9 Watch beta for the Galaxy Watch8 and Watch8 Classic last month, and a few days ago, it rolled out the beta for the Galaxy Watch7 and Galaxy Watch Ultra. Now, Samsung has expanded the One UI 9 Watch beta rollout to the Galaxy Watch6 and Galaxy Watch6 Classic. The One UI 9 Watch beta update for the Galaxy Watch6's 40mm and 44mm models has firmware versions R93xXXU2ZZI1 and R94xXXU2ZZI1, respectively, while the Galaxy Watch6 Classic's 43mm and 47mm models are receiving the update with firmware versions R95xXXU2ZZI1 and R96xXXU2ZZI1. title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max’s triple-rear camera setup detailed
description: The Oppo Find X10 series is set to launch in China this month, with the Pro Max confirmed to feature a triple 200MP rear camera setup. Oppo has now revealed more details about the flagship’s three-camera system. In a post on Weibo, an Oppo executive shared more details about the Find X10 Pro Max’s Hasselblad triple-rear camera setup. The flagship will feature a 200MP primary sensor with DeepPix technology, up to 17EV of dynamic range, and an f/1.5 aperture. It will offer CIPA 6.5 professional-grade stabilization. description: vivo confirmed the launch date for its X500 series at the vivo Creator Festival in China yesterday. The company also shared several details about its upcoming flagship smartphones during the event. The vivo X500 series will launch in China on September 21, the company revealed in a post on Weibo. The lineup will include the base X500, the vivo X500 Pro, and the vivo X500 Pro Max. description: Sony launched its latest flagship smartphone, the Xperia 1 VIII, a few months ago running Android 16. In the meantime, Google has released Android 17, and now Sony seems to have started rolling out the update to the Xperia 1 VIII, according to reports from users on Reddit. title: Huawei Mate XT 2 Ultimate Design is official with a Kirin 9050 Pro SoC, 5,600mAh battery
description: The Huawei Mate XT 2 Ultimate Design has been unveiled in China with a redesign and an inward-folding hinge design. It also features a privacy display, an all new Kirin 9050 Pro chipset, and runs HarmonyOS 7. Huawei’s latest tri-folding smartphone sports a 6.5-inch OLED LTPO cover display with a Full-HD+ resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and a 6,500 nits peak brightness. On the inside, it gets a 10.2-inch OLED 90Hz LTPO panel that has a 3K resolution and a 12.8:9 aspect ratio. The inner panel also features a Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra-like hardware privacy-screen. title: Tecno unveils the Camon Slim 5G with a bunch of unique rear finishes
description: Today Tecno has taken the wraps off the Camon Slim 5G, a phone that does justice to its name by being 6.39mm thin. It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM and 128/256GB of storage. The phone sports a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 1208x2644 resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera using Sony's Lytia 700C 1/1.56" type sensor with OIS, an 8MP ultrawide, a 32MP selfie camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 45W wired charging. title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max is official with a 13.3-inch screen, Xring O3 SoC, and a 12,000 mAh battery
description: Alongside the 18 Fold, Xiaomi today also announced the Pad 9 Pro Max, which is the company's new flagship tablet. The device features a 13.3-inch LCD screen with 3408x2272 resolution, a 3:2 aspect ratio, a 144Hz refresh rate, and a 1,000-nit peak brightness. It's powered by Xiaomi's self-developed Xring O3 chip, just like the Xiaomi 18 Fold. This is paired with 8/12/16GB of RAM and 256GB/512GB/1TB of storage. title: Huawei reveals the Pura X View's full specs, pricing, and launch date
description: Last month, Huawei semi-announced the Pura X View, revealing some but not all of its specs. Today, the company has finally rectified that, by fully unveiling the device with its unique form factor. The Pura X View comes with a 6.39-inch OLED screen with 1320x2232 resolution, 16:9.5 aspect ratio, 120Hz refresh rate, and 6,500-nit peak brightness at 1% APL. The display has Kunlun Glass on top and supports 2,160Hz PWM dimming. It has 1.05mm symmetrical bezels on all four sides. title: Xiaomi 18 Fold is here with the Xring O3 SoC, a wide format, and a cherry red colorway
description: Xiaomi today announced its own very first wide-style foldable smartphone, one-upping Apple by exactly two days. Not only does the Xiaomi 18 Fold have the same form factor as the much-anticipated iPhone Ultra, but it's also available in a cherry red colorway, similar to what was rumored for Apple's device. That's where the similarities end, though. The Xiaomi 18 Fold is powered by Xiaomi's impressive self-developed Xring O3 SoC, paired with 12/16GB of RAM and 256GB/512GB/1TB of storage. description: After launching the Z11x in India in March, now iQOO has quietly unveiled the Z11xa. Its listing is up on the company's website for India, and if you want to have some fun, you can try and find out what's different from the Z11x. [#InlinePriceWidget,14531,1#] Let us spare you the trouble: nothing. The specs are identical, down to the color variants. However, while the Z11x is available with both 6GB and 8GB of RAM and 128GB and 256GB of storage, the Z11xa can only be purchased with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. description: Back in early September of last year, Poco launched the C85 4G. Now, the brand is apparently gearing up to release a successor of sorts. The Poco C95 Pro 4G is allegedly powered by the MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra chipset. It will reportedly have a 6.9-inch 720x1600 LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50MP rear camera, an 8MP front camera, and a 7,500 mAh battery with support for 45W fast wired charging. title: vivo X500 gets certified, its charging support is revealed
description: vivo is going to launch the X500 series this month, and ahead of that the vanilla X500 has been spotted in a bunch of certification databases. It was certified by IMDA in Singapore, SIRIM in Malaysia, as well as TÜV, with the model number V2619. The SIRIM certification confirms that this model number belongs to the X500. IMDA has confirmed that the phone has 5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and NFC, while the TÜV certification reveals that it will support 90W wired charging.
